verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm, so versioned public APIs with a deprecation policy fall outside its product category. Buyers comparing law firms would not reasonably ask this. Its legal-tech offerings (SCC and Term Sheet generators built on Contract Express, Docusign integration, HighQ deal room) are client-facing questionnaire and hosted tools, not developer APIs, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.
